key_points: MCD shares fell to 52‑week lows amid broader restaurant sector weakness.
Dividend yield reached a record 3.06%, underscoring income attractiveness.
CEO says GLP‑1‑driven appetite shrinkage is driving more adult Happy Meal purchases.
Franchisee margins remain healthy with strong borrowing capacity per CFO.
Outlook split: some see 45% upside potential, others warn of sustained traffic pressure.
